coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): all three prompting methods, all three tasks, and fixed random seeds.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies alternative A100-SXM4-80GB/H100 hardware rather than NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB. Does not specify 10 repeated runs per task; 10 warm-up runs and five optional API repetitions do not match. Omits the shared installation of prompting frameworks and BoT repository configuration. Measures per-instance latency in seconds but does not specify the required base-10 logarithmic transformation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time comparison nor the task-specific logarithmic timing values. The reference indicates BoT is slower than Expert on all tasks and slower than PAL on MGSM and Checkmate-in-One, but faster than PAL on Game of 24.
